platforms.note: The nursing page says 'VRpatients works on desktop and browser', but the EMS page names 'Desktop browsers' and the FAQ describes online use on a PC, so Desktop is not listed as a separate platform. key_capabilities.note: CONFLICT on team training: the FAQ says 'At the current time, a single student interacts inside the assigned case', while the EMS page lists 'Train individuals or entire teams' and the military page lists 'Conduct individual or team-based training' and 'Team-Based Tactical Medical Decision Making'. Multiplayer is therefore not listed. CONFLICT on content counts: the authoring-tool meta description says 'more than 20 realistic living environments and a multitude of patient avatars'; the FAQ says 'over 25 living environments and 8 patient avatars'. The FAQ also lists AI dialogue and AI Debriefing/Feedback as authoring variables. Case sharing is limited to the authoring institution (FAQ). The 'No Facilitator' evidence is a short homepage hero label.

target_customer.value: Nursing programs, EMS programs and agencies (EMTs and paramedics), and military medical personnel; the homepage also names schools, hospitals and healthcare workforce learners. Sold by subscription seats per organization.

enabling personnel to train, assess, and maintain critical skills wherever they are deployed.

target_customer.note: Menus list three industries: EMS Education, Nursing Education, Military Training. The FAQ refers to 'accredited educational institutions'. No page names specific customers in body text; the menu links an 'Ohio University Case Study'.

value_proposition.value: Educators build and assign their own customizable patient simulations without coding, and learners practice clinical decisions safely on web, VR or MR at any time, without lab or scheduling limits.

evidence.quote: Its flexible authoring tool and 24/7 access let schools, hospitals, and healthcare workforce learners seamlessly integrate realistic, on-demand training that elevates clinical education and professional development.
With VRpatients®, you create and own your scenarios—tailored to your curriculum.
Students can practice high-risk scenarios without putting real patients in danger.
Traditional labs are expensive, limited, and require scheduling. VR removes these barriers.

value_proposition.note: Cost is also part of the pitch: nursing and EMS pages both carry a 'Lower Cost Than Traditional' section. The homepage cites unnamed research ('one of the top medical schools in Europe').

tagline.value: Real life training without real life consequences.

evidence.quote: VRpatients®, Real life training without real life consequences.
It’s real life training without real life consequences.

tagline.note: Repeated in the footer of all 7 pages read and in the About Us body text. The line itself carries no trademark mark (the ® belongs to 'VRpatients'). Other candidates: homepage hero 'What will you learn today?' (first headline after the menu, split over three lines) and 'One Platform. Every Format.' (homepage heading and meta description). Military page closes with 'Train. Assess. Repeat.'
